name: Hu tieu pizza
summary: Hủ tiếu pizza is the noodle-sheet dish Vietnam Tourism describes after you watch the sheets made: pizza made from the hủ tiếu noodles. It is a workshop tasting, not a separate city pizza tradition.
origin: The noodle village Vietnam Tourism describes in Can Tho.
howToEat: At the workshop, after watching the sheets cooked, dried, and cut.
where: The noodle workshops toward Phong Điền and Mỹ Khánh. A shop name is not part of the plate.
seoTitle: Hu tieu pizza in Can Tho
seoDescription: A noodle-sheet tasting after the hủ tiếu sheets are made, on Vietnam Tourism’s Can Tho place page.
